decision.reason: [ev-d430fc53fc72] is only a one-line entry under Features in the release notes, "Reduce hop token count (#6346)", plus a link to the PR. It doesn't say what the hop token count belongs to (no component, setting, field or API), what the old and new values are, or whether this is a default or a fixed value. It also says nothing about what happens to an environment that does nothing. To decide subject, applicability and consequence we need the PR #6346 description or diff, or upgrade-guide text that names the setting and its before and after values.
